name: remove_full_band_noise
mechanism: The child removes the full-band white-noise floor that added unrealistic high-frequency zero crossings during diastole and instead keeps only band-limited low-frequency sensor noise.
code_snippet: Removed audio += np.random.randn(total_samples) * 0.005; kept audio += bg_noise * noise_level

name: pink_noise_murmur_source
mechanism: Replacing the white-noise murmur source with 1/f pink noise reduces unrealistic high-frequency energy and zero-crossing rate while better matching turbulent blood-flow spectral roll-off.
code_snippet: generate_pink_noise: FFT-shaped white noise scaled by 1/sqrt(f)

name: severity_dependent_noise_beta
mechanism: Replaces fixed pink noise and a fixed 350 Hz resonance with severity-dependent 1/f^beta turbulent source slope, reducing high-frequency energy and broadening spectral diversity.

name: second_order_spectral_tilt
mechanism: A second-order Butterworth low-pass tilt applied with zero-phase filtfilt steepens the murmur's high-frequency rolloff, reducing excessive high-frequency energy and zero-crossing rate.

name: broaden_spectral_tilt_diversity
mechanism: Widening the murmur high-frequency edge and spectral tilt cutoff sampling ranges increases spectral diversity and high-frequency energy coverage, improving zero-crossing rate realism.
code_snippet: murmur_high log-uniform 220-1000 Hz; tilt_cutoff uniform(0.60,1.20)*murmur_high clip 200-1000
